title: A Modern Utopia
summary: "A Modern Utopia" by H. G. Wells is a novel published in 1905. It imagines an identical Earth existing beyond Sirius, where society has evolved differently. Two travelers—the Owner of the Voice and a botanist—explore this world state governed by the Samurai, a voluntary order of nobility. Through their journey, Wells examines political stability, economics, gender equality, and race while blending philosophical discussion with narrative in what has been called a postmodern utopian vision.
